falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes above 5,600 on any day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A new all-time high would invalidate the 77% bottom_2024_aug pattern match, as that pattern formed after a significant decline and required lower prices to resolve; this would prove the current signal is not a bottom but something else entirely

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 12.00 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained sub-12 VIX indicates complacency and risk-on stability, directly contradicting a bottom formation which requires elevated or spiking fear; this would falsify the bottom call and suggest the pattern match is noise

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% while S&P 500 simultaneously trades above 5,400
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This combination of falling yields with rising/rich equities signals a 'goldilocks' or recession-panic dynamic, not a growth-scare bottom; the pattern match to August 2024 bottom fails because that bottom featured yields rising with stocks falling (growth scare), not yields falling with stocks rising

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
